public_configs./root/vibetrading/config/runtime.yaml:
# Long-lived read-only market-data jobs. Credentials are loaded from .env.
collectors:
  # One coordinated KIS job prevents independent commodity/option sessions
  # from racing each other's subscription registrations.
  - provider: kis
    symbols: "auto:all"
  # KIS inquire-investor-time-by-market is a domestic-stock statistic;
  # it must not be labelled KOSPI200 futures foreign flow.
  - provider: kiwoom
    symbols: "@universe"
  - provider: toss
    symbols: "@universe"
strategies: []
# Public perpetual feeds (Arcus quotes USD; other venues quote USDT). Start with the Docker crypto profile after
# capacity validation; no trading credentials are required for collection.
collectors:
  - provider: binance-perp
    symbols: "@crypto"
  - provider: arcus-perp
    symbols: "@crypto"
  - provider: grvt-perp
    symbols: "@crypto"
strategies: []

public_configs./root/vibetrading/deploy/nats.conf:
# Server-wide JetStream limits belong in the NATS configuration file.  The
# market and operations stream caps are enforced separately by nats-init.
jetstream {
  store_dir: "/data"
  max_file_store: 2304MiB
  max_memory_store: 128MiB
  # Per-message fsync stalls publish acknowledgements on this small shared
  # disk.  A bounded one-second journal sync retains a durable replay window
  # without turning transient disk latency into collector-wide backpressure.
  sync_interval: "1s"
}
